confirm.title: Device not found
confirm.description:
The Beurer lamp **{name}** ({mac}) could not be found.

Please ensure:
- The lamp is powered on
- Bluetooth is enabled on your Home Assistant host
- The lamp is within Bluetooth range

Click submit to retry the connection.

confirm.title: Initialization failed
BLE adapter out of connection slots
confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not connect to the Beurer lamp at **{mac}** because the active Bluetooth adapter has reached its concurrent-connection limit.

Typical causes:
- Many BLE devices already connected to the same adapter (BlueZ default cap is around 7).
- A stale connection that was not released.

What to do:
- Reduce the number of simultaneously connected BLE devices, or
- Add an ESPHome / Shelly Bluetooth proxy so the lamp can use a different adapter, or
- Restart the Bluetooth host.

Error reported: `{error}`

Click submit once the situation is resolved to dismiss this issue.

weak_signal.title: Weak Bluetooth signal to {name}
weak_signal.description:
The Bluetooth signal of **{name}** has been very weak for at least 10 minutes (last reading {rssi} dBm). Commands, sunrise simulations and therapy sessions may fail or lag.

What helps:
- Move the lamp closer to the Bluetooth adapter, or
- Add an ESPHome or Shelly Bluetooth proxy near the lamp.

This notice disappears on its own once the signal is better than -78 dBm.

frequent_reconnects.title: {name} keeps losing its Bluetooth connection
frequent_reconnects.description:
**{name}** reconnected {reconnects} times within the last hour (last signal {rssi} dBm). Commands, sunrise simulations and therapy sessions may be interrupted.

What helps:
- Move the lamp closer to the Bluetooth adapter, or
- Add an ESPHome or Shelly Bluetooth proxy near the lamp, or
- Make sure the Beurer LightUp app is not connected at the same time.

This notice disappears on its own once the connection is stable again.
